title: Microwavable Choccy Pud
method: Melt butter in microwave. Whisk in milk, 115g brown sugar, and eggs.
Sift flour, bicarbonate of soda, and 30g cocoa powder into the wet mixture; combine.
Pour batter into a round microwavable dish.
Whisk 135g brown sugar, 20g cocoa powder, and 165ml boiling water; pour gently over batter.
Microwave on high for 8-10 minutes until risen.
